modalities.evidence: fMRI data was obtained through multi-echo fMRI
with EEG to examine brain activity
battery of behavioural and self-report measures

output.population: 62 participants before and after a 19 mg dose of psilocybin; half underwent an 8-week meditation training program
output.summary: Multimodal neuroimaging study of context-dependent psilocybin effects, combining functional, structural and diffusion MRI with EEG before and after dosing, across resting state, guided meditation, music listening and movie watching, with behavioural follow-ups.
